decisions.reason: As a core rye bread that matches the bakery’s everyday assortment and remains easy to justify after other overlapping bread variants were already trimmed, it should stay in the range.
The premium raisin Christmas stollen remains a flagship seasonal product with award-backed prestige and strong fit to the firm’s traditional confectionery identity, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
The seeded rye mixed bread fits steady demand for hearty, slightly more health-oriented breads while staying close to the firm’s established craft strengths, making continuation likely.
The ancient grain bread supports the bakery’s traditional, natural and master-crafted positioning and offers some differentiation within the bread range, so it is likely to be retained.
